text:
Jake: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — seeing a canary failure after the 09:12 deploy (release d-20260305-48) in us-west-2. 5xxs up ~12% on /v1/generate, latency +90ms. incident-bot created INC-3421.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3421 (canary-failure) created and paged oncall. Metadata: service=inference-api, region=us-west-2, metric=5xx_rate, threshold=5%.

Arun: Oncall here. Can someone post the deploy diff/commit that went out?

deploy-bot: Release d-20260305-48 by @Arun — commits: 9f3c2b7 Introduce dynamic batching tweak; 2a4b1f0 Metric change for model router. Canary targets: 10% traffic us-west-2.

Priya: I see elevated error traces in the runtime logs — K-V cache key mismatch when batching certain short prompts. Stacktrace points to commit 9f3c2b7.

Maya: Confirmed. Repro locally with the canary config. Small batching change caused occasional malformed cache lookup -> 502.

Arun: Ok. Options: 1) Kill canary traffic (flip FF), 2) Roll back release, 3) Patch and hotfix.

Jake: Customer impact: currently affects ~3% of active requests in us-west-2 (canary shard) but some downstream retries amplify errors to client-facing 5xxs. CS pinged for customers with active requests. Lina, can you triage impact?

Lina: On it — sending note to top-10 affected customers, flagging support queue. No active P0 customer reports yet but we expect noise.

Priya: Recommend immediate kill-switch for the canary flag to stop new traffic to canary nodes. That avoids a full rollback while we verify.

Arun: Agreed. Who can flip the FF? I can do it but want confirmation.

Jake: Do it. Ping when done. Also include the rollback plan if flipping fails.

Arun: Flipping canary flag now -> @deploy-bot run:```\nfeature-flag set --env prod --flag canary_dynamic_batching --value off --region us-west-2\n```

deploy-bot: Feature flag canary_dynamic_batching set to off in prod/us-west-2 by @Arun. Propagation started.

Priya: Watching metrics. 2m window...

(2 min later)

Priya: Good — 5xx rate trending down. Latency back to baseline. We still have error traces lined up in logs to triage.

Maya: While traffic stabilizes, I'll prepare a minimal hotfix patch to revert the batching change and cut a 1-line fix. We can either roll forward hotfix or revert the commit. Hotfix is faster.

Arun: Hotfix sounds good — small surface area. What's the plan to deploy without re-triggering other changes?

Maya: Branch from release tag d-20260305-48, apply revert to 9f3c2b7 and run smoke canary at 5% in us-west-2 only. CI quick checks (~8m). If green, promote.

Priya: Also add a temporary runtime guard to reject malformed cache keys — safe fallback. I'll open PRs and link them here.

Maya: PRs created: #812 (revert-batching), #813 (runtime-guard). CI passed unit tests early. Starting canary deploy with deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy d-20260305-48-hotfix-1 -> targets us-west-2 5% traffic. Commands run: ```\nredwood deploy promote --from-tag d-20260305-48-hotfix-1 --region us-west-2 --canary 5\n```

Arun: Monitoring. Priya, Maya — if anything flares, we revert the canary and roll back to previous stable release d-20260305-47. Rollback command (preapproved):
```\nredwood deploy rollback --release d-20260305-48 --to d-20260305-47 --region us-west-2\n```

Priya: Canary logs look clean so far. No 502s in last 3 min. Metrics flat.

(5 min later)

Maya: Canary stable. Promoting to 30% for additional confidence.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 30% in progress.

Jake: Great. Lina — update customers: canary disabled and hotfix rolled out to canary; broad rollout in progress. Keep support watchers on high.

Lina: Noted — sending update to affected customers and support channels.

Arun: Postmortem actions (brief): 1) Revert batching tweak permanently until we add serialization checks, 2) Add canary alert for KV mismatch errors, 3) Improve pre-deploy integration test for batching edge cases. I'll own #1 and #3. Priya owns #2.

Priya: Acknowledged. I'll add the alert and short runbook for oncall.

Jake: Closing incident in 30m if metrics remain stable. Thanks team — quick, clean mitigation. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-3421 marked as mitigated by @Arun. Resolution: kill-switch + hotfix canary -> promote.

Arun: I'll file full postmortem doc after we collect traces. For now, update the runbook and tag the commits.

Maya: Notes saved in the deploy thread and PRs. Will attach logs and smoke run screenshots.

Jake: Thanks all. If anything regresses, re-open this thread.
